title: Lucky Man
desc: An unlucky real estate agent experiences a bit of luck when he wins a car in a contest. However, things take a turn after the car is stolen by anonymous assailants.

title: Seetimaarr
desc: A strong-willed coach encounters a series of sinister impediments along his journey to turn a little-known women's kabaddi team into national champions.

title: China Gate
desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: 16 December
desc: Four IRS officers race against the clock to disarm the nuclear bomb planted by a rebel Pakistani terrorist in New Delhi.
